jobs.title: AI Project Manager
jobs.description:
AI Project Manager

Forzo Techlabs

Remote | Full-time

About Forzo Techlabs

Forzo Techlabs (FTL) is a US-headquartered company building AI-powered carbon analytics and inventory platforms — Carbalyze and Carboventory — helping organizations track, manage, and act on emissions data. Alongside our product suite, our customer delivery line delivers technical solutions to clients across global markets. We're a fully remote, distributed team where ownership and cross-functional collaboration matter more than hierarchy.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Project Manager to drive execution across our AI-driven product and customer delivery initiatives. You'll be the connective tissue between engineering, AI architecture, and business stakeholders — turning ambitious roadmaps into shipped, working software. You'll also work closely with our Sales & Marketing function, translating technical capabilities into client-ready narratives and supporting the pipeline that fuels our growth. This role suits someone who understands AI/ML project lifecycles well enough to ask the right questions, spot risk early, and keep delivery on track without needing to write the models themselves.

What You'll Do

●       Own end-to-end project planning and delivery for AI/ML initiatives across Carbalyze, Carboventory, and customer delivery engagements
●       Translate business and client requirements into clear technical scopes, timelines, and milestones in partnership with engineering and AI architecture teams
●       Track project health — timelines, blockers, dependencies, resourcing — and proactively flag risks before they become fires
●       Coordinate across a fully remote, distributed team to keep delivery aligned across time zones
●       Facilitate sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives; keep documentation and status reporting current for leadership and clients
●       Partner with the Sales & Marketing team to support pre-sales efforts — providing technical input for proposals, RFPs, and client pitches, and translating project capabilities into compelling client-facing narratives
●       Contribute delivery proof points, case studies, and technical talking points to support marketing campaigns and sales collateral
●       Partner with stakeholders to manage scope changes, prioritization trade-offs, and expectations
●       Support QA and release coordination for AI-powered features to ensure quality and timely delivery

What You'll Need

●       3–6 years of project management experience, with at least 1–2 years managing AI/ML, data, or software engineering projects
●       Working knowledge of AI/ML project lifecycles (data pipelines, model development, evaluation, deployment) — you don't need to build models, but you need to speak the language
●       Strong track record with agile delivery methods (Scrum/Kanban) and tools like Jira, Asana, or similar
●       Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally with Sales & Marketing to support pipeline, proposals, and client-facing initiatives
●       Excellent stakeholder management skills — comfortable working directly with technical leads, clients, and leadership
●       Sharp written and verbal communication; able to distill technical complexity for non-technical audiences
●       Comfortable operating in a fully remote, fast-paced startup environment where you'll wear multiple hats

Nice to Have

●       Azure or AWS certification
●       Exposure to building or managing agentic AI systems and traditional ML solutions
●       Exposure to client-facing delivery in a services/consulting context

Why FTL

●       Work at the intersection of AI and climate impact
●       Fully remote — work from anywhere, on a team that's built that way from the ground up
●        Direct access to leadership and real ownership over how projects run

jobs.description:

Willow is a telehealth company focused on personalized, responsible cosmetic weight loss care. We combine medical expertise with a supportive, patient-centered approach to help people feel more confident and comfortable in their bodies. Our goal is to make high-quality care accessible, thoughtful, and designed to fit real lives.

Serving as the entry point for Marketing initiatives, building project briefs from the ground up, identifying the right stakeholders, and driving timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple teams.

Product launches & go-to-market:

Data visibility & decision making:
Helping surface and communicate relevant Marketing data to support faster, more informed decisions.

Requirements

3-6+ years of experience in marketing project management, marketing operations, integrated marketing, or similar operational roles
Experience working in a fast-paced startup, high-growth, or similarly dynamic environment
Demonstrated experience taking cross-functional projects from early-stage concept or loosely defined request through scoping and execution
Experience managing complex Marketing initiatives, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables simultaneously
Advanced expertise in at least one major project management platform (ClickUp, Monday.com, Asana, or equivalent)
Demonstrated experience architecting project management systems: workflows, automations, templates, intake processes, dependencies, dashboards, and reporting
Experience implementing workflow automation and integrating tools across business processes
Strong familiarity with AI tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation platforms, or agentic systems, with the ability to rapidly learn emerging technologies
Experience facilitating the rollout and adoption of new systems, tools, and workflows across teams
Strong familiarity with Marketing workflows across Creative, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Content, Web/Ecommerce, Affiliate, Brand, and Product Launches
Comfortable building systems, templates, briefs, processes, and operational documentation from the ground up
Comfortable working with Marketing performance data and reporting
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong judgment around prioritization, resource allocation, and escalation
High level of ownership, accountability, and independent problem solving

Nice to Have

Experience implementing agentic AI workflows or AI-powered operational systems
Experience with automation and integration tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato, or similar platforms
Experience connecting project management platforms with Slack, data sources, reporting tools, or other business systems
Experience building sophisticated ClickUp, Monday.com, or Asana environments from the ground up

Experience supporting complex cross-functional initiatives where requirements were not fully defined at the outset
Experience supporting launch operations in fast-paced consumer brands

jobs.description:
Job Posting:

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

The IT Implementation Project Manager
is responsible for leading and coordinating the successful delivery of IT infrastructure projects that support Ferguson's branch and corporate operations. This role manages the planning, execution, and implementation of voice, data, network, wireless, and telecommunications initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with business and technical requirements.

Working closely with Engineering, Facilities, vendors, and business collaborators, the IT Implementation Project Manager manages a range of overlapping projects differing in size and complexity, including new branch openings, relocations, renovations, infrastructure upgrades, and technology deployments. This position is accountable for project execution, budget management, stakeholder communication, vendor coordination, and ensuring all implementations meet company standards and operational requirements.

Location: This role is approved to be fully remote and can be based anywhere in the United States.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Manage and deliver multiple IT infrastructure and implementation projects, ensuring scope, timelines, budgets, and business objectives are achieved.
Coordinate network, voice, wireless, cabling, and infrastructure deployments for branch and corporate locations.
Review site surveys, technical documentation, and construction plans to define project requirements and implementation plans.
Partner with Facilities, Engineering, vendors, and business collaborators on new builds, relocations, renovations, and technology upgrades.
Manage vendor relationships, including Statements of Work (SOWs), Bills of Materials (BOMs), procurement, and contractor activities.
Oversee installation, testing, and validation of infrastructure solutions, ensuring compliance with company and industry standards.
Coordinate voice, data, and network services while ensuring MDF/IDF, cabling, and hardware installations meet requirements.
Maintain project documentation, budgets, purchase orders, and updates within ServiceNow, CMDB, and project management tools.
Provide project communications, status reporting, and customer updates throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with Engineering, Project Management, and Support teams to ensure successful implementations and operational readiness.
Perform additional duties as assigned.

Other Responsibilities:

Represent Ferguson professionally while providing excellent customer service.
Follow all company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.
Support company initiatives, goals, and continuous improvement efforts.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, and implementation projects.
Understanding of project management principles and standard processes.
Experience with Microsoft Office, ServiceNow, Oracle, Visio, and related project management tools.
Strong leadership, organizational, and project coordination skills.
Good communication, presentation, and customer management abilities.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to handle multiple priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams.
Good interpersonal and facilitation skills with the ability to form relationships across all levels of the organization.

Qualifications:

2-4 years of experience in IT project coordination/management, IT infrastructure implementation, telecommunications, networking, or a related technology environment.
Experience supporting or managing IT infrastructure projects, including structured cabling, inside and outside plant connectivity, and Ethernet and copper-based network environments.
Working knowledge of voice and data technologies, including VoIP, routing, switching, wireless networking, and telecommunications infrastructure.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and ServiceNow.
Experience with Visio, SharePoint, or other diagramming and collaboration tools.
Ability to effectively prioritize workload and manage multiple concurrent projects while meeting deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise good judgment in a fast-paced environment.
Strong time management, organizational, and project coordination skills.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality results.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, processes, and business requirements and apply them effectively.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex issues involving service providers, network infrastructure, hardware, and related technologies.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with technical and non-technical participants.
Proven ability to collaborate across multi-functional teams and build strong working relationships with internal associates, vendors, and project partners.

At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more!

jobs.description:
Location: Hershey, PA (Remote)

Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

About The Hershey Company

The Hershey Company is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our One Hershey mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

How will you fit in the big picture?

The Program Manager is responsible for the successful delivery and governance of the BIP portfolio, leading complex, cross-functional programs across multiple business, data, and technology domains. This role drives program execution, coordination, and operational excellence across the platform, ensuring initiatives are delivered on schedule, aligned with business priorities, and positioned to generate measurable business value. The Program Manager works closely with Business Product Owners, IS Product and Platform leaders, architects, engineering teams, and delivery partners to manage dependencies, risks, resources, governance, and stakeholder communications while supporting long-term platform strategy and adoption.

The Business Intelligence Platform (BIP) is Hershey's enterprise analytics consumption layer, enabling Commercial leaders to access insights, make decisions, and drive action. Built on the Enterprise Data Foundation (EDF), BIP is a unified, product-oriented platform organized around business-aligned pods including Consumer, Customer, Supply Chain, and Commercial. These teams deliver analytics, reporting, and AI-driven capabilities through iterative delivery cycles, helping transform the organization from reactive reporting to predictive, real-time, decision-driven insights.

What will you do?

Lead Program Delivery and Execution

Own integrated program delivery across BIP pods and shared workstreams, managing schedules, dependencies, risks, assumptions, issues, and critical milestones from planning through deployment and adoption.
Drive Agile and Scaled Agile delivery practices, including planning events, cross-team coordination, sprint reviews, and execution governance.
Maintain visibility to program health, delivery progress, backlog readiness, and critical path activities across the portfolio.
Ensure delivered solutions generate measurable business value and support enterprise objectives.

Drive Governance and Stakeholder Alignment

Establish and maintain effective governance, decision-making processes, operating rhythms, and escalation paths.
Lead executive updates, steering committee reviews, and stakeholder communications, providing clear status, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations.
Partner with business and technology leaders to align priorities, manage expectations, and drive accountability across teams.
Coordinate dependencies and interlocks with related enterprise initiatives and shared technology platforms.

Influence Solution Delivery and Technical Strategy

Collaborate with architecture, engineering, product, and data leadership teams to ensure delivery plans align with enterprise standards, long-term platform roadmaps, and business priorities.
Support the evaluation and resolution of complex program, integration, scalability, and operational challenges.
Promote delivery approaches that support sustainable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

Lead Resource, Financial, and Vendor Management

Manage resource planning, staffing readiness, capacity allocation, onboarding, and utilization across internal teams, global resources, and external partners.
Support budget management, forecasting, financial tracking, and investment planning activities.
Monitor vendor performance, delivery quality, and adherence to established methodologies and governance standards.
Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, and leadership teams to address staffing needs and program resource requirements.

Promote Delivery Excellence and Organizational Capability

Establish repeatable delivery processes, templates, quality standards, and governance practices that enable consistent execution across the portfolio.
Ensure readiness activities, quality gates, testing approaches, and delivery controls are in place for successful implementation.
Drive continuous improvement and organizational maturity in program management practices.
Support development of internal capabilities to create sustainable, long-term program management excellence.

Experience

Minimum Education & Requirements

7+ years of program/project management experience delivering complex, cross-functional technology or data & analytics programs, ideally in a large enterprise or CPG environment.
Demonstrated success leading Agile / SAFe delivery at scale — PI planning, scrum-of-scrums, and multi-pod coordination — with formal training or certification (e.g., PMP, SAFe, CSM) strongly preferred.
Proven ability to manage blended teams of internal FTEs, offshore/onshore managed-services resources, and external delivery partners.
Strong financial and resource-management acumen — budget tracking, Capital vs. expense, and vendor/rate-card management.
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a track record of producing decision-ready materials for senior leaders.

Preferred Experience

Experience with data platform, business intelligence, or AI/analytics programs (e.g., Databricks, Power BI, conversational/agentic analytics).
Familiarity with product-operating models (two-in-a-box business/IS ownership) and adoption-driven delivery metrics.
Prior experience standing up program governance and hiring/resourcing trackers for a new or scaling program.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Benefits And Perks

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health
Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.

jobs.description:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Technical Project Manager

Salary

$60k-$80k

Company Description

StrataBlue is an AI-first digital agency with over 18 years of experience building AI-powered marketing, sales, and operational systems for mid-market companies.

Job Description

You will own projects end-to-end, serving as the bridge between technical execution and client strategy. By designing complex workflows and leading development sprints, you’ll ensure the delivery of high-impact AI automation solutions. This role requires a hands-on builder capable of translating business requirements into scalable, automated architectures that drive significant revenue for clients.

Location

Remote

Why this role is remarkable

Work at the cutting edge of AI automation, building real-world solutions in tools like n8n and Make rather than just managing tickets.
Join an established 18-year-old agency that has successfully pivoted to an AI-first model, delivering systems that have generated over $11M in sales for clients.
Enjoy high autonomy and direct reporting to the Managing Partner in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your contributions have immediate impact.

What You Will Do

Design and document sophisticated business processes and workflow architectures to be implemented within AI-powered systems.
Manage distributed development teams through daily standups, sprint planning, and rigorous QA to ensure high-quality technical delivery.
Lead client-facing engagements, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and maintaining trust throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate

3-7 years of experience in technical project management, specifically within an agency or consultancy environment managing offshore development teams.
Hands-on proficiency with AI automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier and advanced workflow management tools like ClickUp.
Self-motivated and action-oriented professional with a strong customer service mindset and the ability to work independently during EST business hours.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

Self-directed leader with a full driving license who is willing to work occasional nights and weekends to support frontline rail deployments.

As we plan, design, and manage projects that move people and goods from Point A to Point B, we create connections that transform our communities. Every airport, road, bridge, port, or transit project is an opportunity to make communities safer, cleaner, and more resilient. Together, we’re making an impact around the world.

If you’re looking for a career that moves, join our team of professionals who are passionate about the future of transportation.

The Alberta Transportation team is a vibrant group, focused on delivering innovative solutions for today’s civic challenges throughout the Western Canada and the Northern Territories. Building on each other’s talents, we collaborate across all disciplines to execute projects of all sizes and complexities – from roadway, traffic, structural, environmental, water, power, digital technologies, and more - to make our communities safer, more resilient, and exciting places to live and work.

We encourage our team to push the limits in an innovative and energetic environment, focusing on developing our team’s skillsets while advancing individual careers. We routinely engage with experts throughout North America, making the most of today’s technology and being the first to create new ones. With over 34,000 employees worldwide and more than 500 in Alberta, you will have access to global expertise while working alongside our close-knit regional team.

We’re driving the future of transportation infrastructure. This is a place to apply your passion and grow with endless opportunities to help advance communities, today and tomorrow. We create great places and connections that get people and goods moving—whether by car, bus, train, plane, bike, scooter, or their own two feet. Working within the context of the communities we serve, we provide planning, engineering, and infrastructure management services that fit the needs of our clients and improve the overall transportation experience. Join our team and help us keep communities connected.

Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking a Project Manager to join our growing Transportation practice in Alberta. You will engage with all aspects of our transportation and associated practices around Canada including roadway, traffic, multimodal, transit, planning and design, structural, environmental, hydraulic experts, and more. The person in this position will need a strong emphasis in project management and transportation engineering in the areas of roadways, civil, and drainage, highways and roadways/freeways.

Opportunity provides for a hybrid work environment. In office presence is expected based on project needs, client meetings, and team collaboration

Your Key Responsibilities

Manage projects, delivery, and QA for the design of roadways/highways, intersections/interchanges and associated facilities to meet local, provincial and federal requirements.
Manage the development of scopes of work, level of effort estimates, and project schedules.
Provide mentorship and quality control for plan, specification, and estimate package preparation and submittal.
Assist in the leadership and management of an established yet developing regional practice including mentorship of engineering staff.
Support account management teams in establishing and maintaining relationships with key clients throughout Alberta and Northern Canada
Offer creative planning and pursuit strategy solutions that support multi-disciplinary collaboration, client goals and objectives, and support and/or lead the pursuit strategy for projects including proposal development.
Be familiar with alternate forms of project delivery such as design build.
Support the creation of a diverse and driven culture developing tomorrow’s engineering solutions.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

Professional Engineering Registration in Alberta required and knowledge of local conditions and environment.
Familiarity with local, provincial and federal design guidelines and regulatory requirements.
Ability to manage transportation staff in successful delivery of projects.
Proposal preparation experience; project management; project design experience; contract negotiation.
Strong leadership, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
High level of proficiency with Microsoft suite of Office 365 products.
Valid drivers license and good driving record required.

Education and Experience

Bachelors of Science Degree in Civil Engineering or greater.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) license in Alberta.
Minimum 12 years of combined experience in transportation project management and delivery.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

About Stantec

Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible.

xAmplify – Leading Australia’s Digital Evolution

At xAmplify, we’re shaping Australia’s future by combining intelligent automation with human‑centred technology services to deliver real impact across government and enterprise.

Our vision is bold — to accelerate the safe and secure adoption of Automation and AI across Australia.

We partner with some of the world’s most innovative technology providers to bring cutting‑edge solutions into real‑world environments, helping organisations transform how they operate, make decisions, and deliver services.

For our people, this means working on meaningful projects, solving complex problems, and being part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and growth.

Proven experience working as a Project Manager
on contract engagements, ideally within IT or ERP projects

Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences
Solid understanding of project delivery frameworks (Agile, PRINCE2, or hybrid)
Highly organised with strong communication and problem-solving capabilities

Thrive in fast-paced environments

Our Enterprise, State Government, Local Government, and Private Sector Projects

Full Australian working rights, which can include an appropriate visa If you’re unsure on how your eligibility aligns, feel free to connect with us—we’d love to connect and chat!

Our team operates on a hybrid work model, so you will have the ability to work from our office, client sites (as required with your allocated projects) or from home.

Contractor

Joining xAmplify

At xAmplify, you’ll be part of a high‑growth, people‑first technology consultancy where your work has real impact. We take our culture pretty seriously which is why we have an awesome XVP in place that outlines and promise to you and your journey with xAmplify.

Competitive benefits, rewards, and recognition through Employment Hero and WhereFit
Clear career pathways, certifications, and opportunities across automation, ERP, business transformation, cyber and beyond
A connected national team with regular engagement, learning, and collaboration opportunities
A culture built on diversity, inclusion, and community impact through our own xAmplify Foundation

We almost forgot to mention that we’re a Great Place to Work Certified organisation and we’ve recently made the 2026 Best Workplaces in Technology so you know you’re joining an organisation that’s people first!

Ready to Apply?

Ready to play a key role in Australia’s digital evolution? Apply now!
The future isn’t just coming — we’re creating it.

jobs.description:
About the Business

Under the Pallas Group umbrella, we have two purpose-driven, ambitious brands inspired by a passion for excellence within the funds management and property industries.

Pallas Capital is a debt and equity fund manager specialising in the financing of Australian and New Zealand Commercial Real Estate. The business was established in direct response to the growing lack of credit in Australia’s mid-range property market; a situation exacerbated by the shortage of reputable, risk-adverse, non-bank lenders.

Fortis our property development management business, has a portfolio of more than $1 billion in successfully completed residential and commercial projects, with a further $900 million to be completed by the end of the year.

Due to continued growth, Pallas Capital is seeking a highly motivated and versatile professional to join the team in Manly in a unique hybrid role combining Program Manager for the Highly Sprung TP52 yacht program (70%) and Client Services Associate (30%).

As Program Manager, you will lead the operational, technical and commercial delivery of Highly Sprung, Pallas Capital's sponsored TP52 yacht program and one of Australia's premier offshore racing campaigns. This includes overseeing racing campaigns, crew management, vessel performance, event delivery and premium client engagement experiences for high-net-worth investors and stakeholders. You will play a key role in ensuring the program continues to deliver elite sporting performance while supporting Pallas Capital's client relationship and brand objectives.

As a Client Services Associate, you will support the investor operations team across client communications, onboarding, KYC/AML compliance, application processing, unit registry administration and ongoing investor servicing.

This is a rare opportunity to combine involvement in a world-class sailing program with a career in a leading private credit and real estate investment business.

Key Responsibilities – Program Manager, Highly Sprung TP52 (70%)

Lead the delivery of a high-performance TP52 racing program competing in Australia's premier offshore and inshore sailing events.
Manage all aspects of race preparation, logistics, campaign planning and performance optimisation.
Recruit, lead and develop a high-performing crew of professional and semi-professional sailors.
Oversee vessel maintenance, technical operations, safety compliance and performance upgrades.
Coordinate major sailing events, regattas and client engagement experiences across Australia.
Host and engage high-net-worth investors, clients and stakeholders during sailing events.
Manage program budgets, suppliers and operational requirements.
Act as a brand ambassador for Pallas Capital, ensuring all experiences reflect the organisation's values and commitment to excellence.

Key Responsibilities – Client Services Associate (30%)

Support investor onboarding, KYC/AML compliance and application processing.
Liaise with investors and internal stakeholders across Distribution, Product and Finance teams.
Process investor transactions including applications, redemptions and unit certificate issuance.
Assist with interest payment reviews, reconciliations and fund administration activities.
Prepare reports and perform data analysis to support operational and commercial decision-making.
Build and maintain reports using Excel and other business systems.
Support process improvement initiatives, system enhancements and data quality projects.
Maintain CRM records and investor data to a high standard of accuracy.
Contribute to new product launches, business initiatives and ad hoc projects.
Deliver exceptional service to investors and internal stakeholders.

About You

Offshore and/or inshore racing experience, preferably within high-performance sailing programs.
Proven leadership experience managing teams, events or sporting campaigns.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience delivering premium client, hospitality or corporate event experiences.
Highly organised with strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Commercially minded with a passion for building relationships and delivering exceptional experiences.
An interest in financial markets, investment management or real estate will be highly regarded.

Why Pallas Group

The people are entrepreneurial; the business is young and proving itself fast, it is a great time to join the group. Pallas is committed to growth and to involving high performers in the achievement of results. The role suits candidates with energy, ambition and technical capability.
This is a real opportunity for someone to make an impact and show what they are capable of next. Importantly, we seek to make Pallas Group a great place to work. We care for our team inside and outside of work, and we provide a dynamic work environment where we work together collaboratively. Given our size, our people are given the opportunity to make a difference, own the work they do and grow their career as the business continues grow.

To Apply

Please submit your application by clicking the 'Apply' button below and ensure you include your full CV. Applications are accepted for a 4-week period, ending 18 September 2026.

Please note that due to the volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We appreciate your understanding.

jobs.title: Renewals Strategy Principal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3. Please refer to our Compensation section below to see what neighborhoods fall under each Zone.

Role Description

Dropbox is entering an exciting new chapter in how we support, retain, and grow our customers.

As part of our evolving go-to-market strategy, Customer Experience & Success (CXS) will assume ownership of commercial renewals, creating a unique opportunity to rethink how we drive customer retention and long-term recurring revenue. We're looking for an experienced strategy and operations leader to help shape Dropbox's retention strategy, modernize our renewal operating model, and build the capabilities that enable customers to realize ongoing value from Dropbox.

As the Renewals Strategy Principal Program Manager
you'll lead the strategy, operating model, and execution behind this transformation. You'll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, Legal, and Engineering to develop retention strategies, design scalable programs, and build the playbooks, operating rhythms, and automation that enable Customer Success to successfully own a significant renewal business.

This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys designing scalable business capabilities, and is passionate about leveraging AI, automation, and data to improve customer retention and operational excellence. You'll identify new opportunities to reduce churn, increase customer engagement, simplify workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes while helping establish Customer Success as a world-class retention organization.

Over time, you'll help shape Dropbox's long-term customer lifecycle strategy, evolving our approach to customer retention across direct, channel, and self-serve motions.

Responsibilities

Lead Dropbox's retention strategy for commercial customers, identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes and recurring revenue.
Develop scalable retention programs, renewal strategies, and customer lifecycle initiatives that increase customer health, product adoption, and renewal rates.
Partner with Customer Success and Sales leadership to evolve the renewal operating model as Customer Success assumes ownership of commercial renewals.
Design playbooks, operating rhythms, and best practices that enable Customer Success to proactively identify and mitigate renewal risk.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to improve customer engagement, reduce manual work, and increase operational efficiency.
Partner with Product, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Engineering to improve the end-to-end customer renewal experience.
Establish data-driven frameworks for renewal forecasting, customer health, retention analytics, and executive reporting.
Analyze customer behavior and renewal performance to identify trends, recommend strategic investments, and continuously improve retention outcomes.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer lifecycle management and drive long-term recurring revenue growth.
Influence senior leaders across the business to align on customer retention priorities and operational improvements.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in SaaS strategy, renewals, customer lifecycle management, customer success, revenue operations, or commercial operations.
Experience designing, building, or scaling renewal, retention, or recurring revenue programs within a B2B SaaS environment.
Deep expertise in renewal strategy, forecasting, customer retention, and recurring revenue operations.
Experience building scalable operating models, processes, playbooks, governance, or customer programs that improved business performance.
Experience leading new initiatives or organizational transformations from concept through operational execution.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional programs and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong strategic thinking with a demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operational execution.
Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical skills with experience using data to drive operational decisions, prioritize investments, and measure business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within or alongside Customer Success organizations
Experience supporting multi-product SaaS portfolios
Experience implementing renewal and retention playbooks or lifecycle revenue frameworks
Exposure to evolving SaaS pricing models such as usage-based or hybrid pricing

Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.

Company Description

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

Team Description

The Dropbox Customer Experience and Success (CXS) Team shapes how more than 700 million users and 575k teams worldwide interact with our products. We turn insights into actions, bringing empathy and expertise to every touchpoint. Our team embraces resourcefulness and curiosity, pushing boundaries—and ourselves—to improve the customer experience and ensure our customers achieve their desired outcomes with our products, leading to increased customer lifetime value, retention, and growth. Every team member contributes their unique perspective as we collaborate across the organization to amplify the customer voice. If you're passionate about bringing joy, humanity, and simplicity to how people interact with Dropbox, join our Customer Experience and Success team.

Virtual First

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

AI Fluency

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

We Look For Four Key Behaviors In Candidates

Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. To learn more, see our approach to AI in hiring.

Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.title: Program Manager Contingent Workforce
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's Talent Team is at an inflection point in how we manage external workforce: our contingent population has grown steadily, and there is now an opportunity to build and mature the governance, policy, and program infrastructure to match that growth. We're hiring a Lead Contingent Workforce Program Manager to inherit our newly launched MSP/VMS platform (Beeline + Monument) and turn it into a fully governed, scalable program — with clear policies, a trusted supplier network, and a compliance-first operating model. This role sits at the intersection of vendor management, workforce planning, and risk, and reports to the Head of Talent, working closely with Finance, Legal, Accounting, and IT. Twelve months from now, this person will have built a comprehensive playbook giving Instacart even greater visibility and insight into its contingent workforce.

What You'll Cook Up In Your First Year

A fully operational program, not just a platform. You'll take this project from a newly launched system of record to a program with governance frameworks, standard operating procedures, and clear accountability structures — giving Instacart a durable operating model for its contingent workforce, not just new software.
A trusted, well-governed supplier network. As the primary Instacart point of contact for Monument (MSP) and Beeline (VMS), you'll manage the approved supplier network and own onboarding and offboarding, ensuring every supplier operates within Instacart's rate, compliance, and worker classification frameworks.
Policies that hold up under audit. Partnering with Legal and Accounting, you'll refine and operationalize worker classification and tenure management policies that are SOX audit-ready, further strengthening the controls needed to scale the program.
A hiring manager population that adopts the model without friction. Through communications, training, and enablement materials, you'll drive organizational adoption of the new contingent workforce model — making compliant engagement of external labor the path of least resistance.
A roadmap that takes the program beyond launch. You'll own what comes next — international expansion via a centralized EOR, platform enhancements, and improved spend reportability — identifying evolving needs as the program matures and bringing stakeholders along to address those needs.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have Pantry Staples (Minimum Qualifications)

7+ years of experience in program management, operations, or workforce management, with a demonstrated track record of building programs from scratch in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Experience managing vendor or supplier relationships, ideally in a staffing, MSP, or VMS context.
Strong process development skills — you design operating models, not just execute against them.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across Finance, Legal, HR, and business stakeholders.
Comfortable leading a newly launched program where the playbook is still being built — you’ll write it.
Exceptional communication and influencing skills, including at the executive level.

Optional Garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience with contingent workforce management platforms (e.g., Beeline, SAP Fieldglass, Workday) or MSP programs.
Familiarity with employment law, worker classification, or SOX compliance in an HR or workforce context.
Background in HR, Talent, or People Operations.
Experience leading international workforce programs or employer-of-record (EOR) engagements.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Technical Program Manager for Wind Blade Repair Development Engineering will lead and coordinate key programs supporting repair development, process readiness, and scale-up initiatives. This role partners across Engineering, Fleet Performance Engineering, Sourcing, and Services to drive execution, standardization, and continuous improvement across repair development activities. The successful candidate will bring strong program management discipline, cross-functional leadership, and process improvement capability, with the ability to support both strategic priorities and day-to-day execution in a hands-on technical environment.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate programs within Wind Blade Repair Development Engineering.
Drive program execution through planning, prioritization, action management, and stakeholder alignment.
Support budget planning and management for assigned programs.
Partner with the team on problem solving, planning, and execution support.
Own and maintain action tracking to ensure timely follow-up and closure.
Facilitate daily stand-ups and help drive team operating rhythm.
Participate in and support shop trials, including coordination and follow-up.
Support WDI updates and related program communications/documentation.
Generate and support ECR/ECOs, as needed.
Partner with Sourcing and Services Procurement to support program execution and scale-up readiness.
Support development and execution of PFMEA activities.
Develop and maintain process maps, control plans, and Cycle Time / Value Stream Mapping (CT/VSM).
Own training material development and support train-the-trainer efforts.
Establish structure and expectations for documentation, including capturing work output and lessons learned from trials.
Support technical teams by capturing media, process data, and related documentation.
Take on technical assignments, as needed, to support team objectives.
Provide training and mentorship for Program Managers.
Support Repair BOM activities, including initial definition, sourcing checks to verify suitability for scaling, and handoff support to Services Procurement team.
Support ECR/ECO activity for part number creation in PLM.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university or college.
Minimum 7 years of experience in program management, engineering, manufacturing, operations, or related technical environments.

Desired Qualifications

Demonstrated experience working with teams to collaborate, influence others, and achieve desired project goals.
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Experience with engineering, manufacturing, repair development, or process improvement programs.
Familiarity with PFMEA, process mapping, control plans, and value stream mapping.
Working knowledge of Six Sigma DMAIC methodology & tools.
Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
Ability to drive structure, standardization, and continuous improvement.
Experience developing training materials and supporting knowledge transfer.
Ability to work effectively in a hands-on, team-oriented environment.
Experience with composite materials and processing.

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

Annual bonus eligible

Summer Fridays....all year round

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
This position is in Santa Rosa, in the heart of California’s beautiful wine country, is the corporate headquarters of Keysight, home to many product development R&D labs. The Digital and Photonics R&D team in Santa Rosa develops and produces the world’s highest performance oscilloscopes.
You will work in close collaboration with a diverse multi-functional team of engineers, scientists, and researchers around the globe to meet the communications electronics measurement challenges of today and tomorrow. Giving customers insight into developing digital communication and Internet infrastructure signals and devices is our focus. Keysight is committed to providing innovative measurement solutions that enable our customers and partners to deliver the products and services that make a measurable difference in the lives of people everywhere.
Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of multi-talented software engineers to invent, design, and develop new, world-leading time-domain measurement instruments, working with a multi-functional, global team to deliver instrument software integrated into hardware to develop complete instruments from concept to full manufacturing shipment.
Quickly learn the software architecture of sampling oscilloscopes, taking ownership to imagine, define, plan and execute one or more software releases per year to deliver new oscilloscope products and/or measurement features to market. Provide customer-valued performance, robustness, and flexibility within cost, schedule and scope constraints.
Lead your software team through the full software product development lifecycle. Work to balance customer-facing requirements with pragmatic technical judgement to align on scope, investment cost, and schedule. Learn and follow the Keysight product lifecycle, respecting standards of business conduct and export control restrictions.
Execute quality software development processes with product backlog definition, sprint planning, feature & issue prioritization, QA, and release deployment. Practice secure SW development. Manage technical debt (OS refresh/toolchain evolution/architecture refactoring) with customer-facing scope in each release plan.
Collaborate with sampling scope, OF NPI and DP-COE leadership team. Sampling scopes is a fast-paced, dynamic team where hardware and software operating managers who collaborate to efficiently complete multiple synergistic new product introductions. We also work extensively with customer-facing in-bound marketing, field sales force, Keysight Labs, and leaders of our large global manufacturing organization.
Grow engineering talent. Evaluate, coach and reward to maximize individual performance and support the success of our sampling R&D teams
Support customers. Present technical information of value to customers, occasionally visiting global customer sites to present products and help customers with integration in a dynamically changing technology environment, continuous learning is expected and supported throughout your career.

Qualifications

This position requires both significant software development knowledge and electronic product knowledge to make timely design and execution path risk tradeoff decisions. Relevant technical background of successful candidate will most likely be in software engineering with significant project execution experience.
Open to individuals with a track record of leading engineering teams to deliver projects involving new software integrated with new hardware design within time/cost/scope constraints. Educational background most likely includes a BS or MS degree in an Engineering major including strong skills in software development with 2-4 years of related project leadership experience to draw upon.
One or more examples of software project leadership. Ability to discuss performance, cost, and schedule tradeoffs, arrive at an aligned execution plan & track progress. One or more examples of how changes to plan were handled.
Demonstrated success in leading software development projects with skill in backlog management, sprint planning, and progress tracking. Knowledge of SW quality practices. Evidence of excellent leadership of triage & troubleshooting, and issue resolution skills.
Enjoy working with a diversemulti-functional team to deliver prototype designs into volume manufacturing on a global scale. Evidence of talent development skills & optimizing team productivity and creativity
Demonstration of excellent communication and teamwork skills, enjoying working with a diverse and global team. Ability to persuasively advocate for resources to remove roadblocks to speed project execution
Strong problem-solving and quantitative data analysis skills. Evidence of experience with budget management, factory cost versus net profit versus product scope tradeoffs in a quantitative data-driven analysis.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies and lead a team through change.
Excellent time management, and ability to work independently in supportive team of available mentors
Significant pluses:
Evidence of ability to lead strategic discussions, for example future roadmap development. Evidence of ability to make crisp and accurate tactical decisions with incomplete/ambiguous information, and then articulately explain & recruit support.
Ability to quickly learn to correctly set up optical and electrical measuring instruments to demonstrate and test the desired measurement. Enjoys hands-on exploration to find correct instrument setups to evaluate your software/hardware integration quality
Evidence of handling new IP protection, and export control requirements. Ability to persuasively represent technical expertise to end-use customers is highly desired
Specific examples of high-risk tradeoff decisions and ability to explain the method by which the decision was made

Other Information

This position is on-site in Santa Rosa, California

Reporting to the Director of IT Portfolio & Planning, the Senior Program Manager
is a full-time role responsible for the delivery of high-profile technology transformation initiatives, spanning numerous product and service delivery teams across the IT organization and relevant stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities

Program Governance – Establish program governance for complex technology transformation programs requiring various technology and stakeholder teams to work together to drive program success.
Delivery Planning – Establish delivery plans for key initiatives, balancing objectives and competing priorities across multiple product teams. Work across technology teams and stakeholders provide resourcing plans as required.
Delivery Management – Lead key programs from inception to completion through the management and orchestration of sub-projects spanning multiple teams working within product development cycles.
Sequencing & Dependency Management – Manage dependencies of varying complexity at program level, potentially informing and feeding into larger portfolios.
Communications – Responsible for all proactive and reactive communications for program sponsors and stakeholders.
Escalation Management – Act as the initial singular escalation point for multifaceted program deliveries, proposing mitigation strategies and corrective action.
Fiscal Governance – Effective budget management within the constraints of enterprise-wide programs and their constituent projects, contributing to establishing the appropriate level or monitoring and control mechanisms required.
Commercial Management – Identify, propose and deploy appropriate frameworks and purchasing strategies in collaboration with internal commercial colleagues.
Strategic Alignment – Liaise with both the Enterprise Architecture and Digital Steering teams to ensure that key initiatives continue to adhere to technology strategies and enterprise priorities respectively.
Other responsibilities as assigned and consistent with the role.

Education/Certification

Post-secondary education within an Information Technology or Engineering Field.
Project and/or Program level certification of any framework (i.e. PMP, PRINCE2) is advantageous but not mandatory.
Any Agile and Product Management related certification is advantageous but not mandatory.

Experience

7+ years of experience delivering large, complex technology initiatives with exposure across multiple technology domains, including Applications, Software Development, Data & Analytics, Infrastructure, Platforms, Cybersecurity, Digital Products, and Technology Operations.
Demonstrated experience leading business transformation initiatives enabled by technology, with measurable organizational, operational, or customer outcomes.
Experience delivering within one or more technology disciplines such as software engineering, data and analytics, technology operations, resilience, cybersecurity, risk management, enterprise architecture, or digital transformation.

Agile & Lean – Ability to lead on a range of Agile and Lean tools and techniques, providing coaching and mentorship outside of the immediate team.

Self-Direction – The ability to work independently, establish relationships, and maintain context of multiple project deliveries simultaneously.

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. If you're ready to lead impactful projects and grow alongside a passionate team, we invite you to take on this exciting challenge and make a difference. This role is located in Atlanta, GA.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

Experience with stakeholder engagement and executive-level communication

.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

MetaComp Pte Ltd is a leading Singapore-based digital payment solution provider, licensed and regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) as a Major Payment Institution, to provide Digital Payment Token Services and Cross-border Payment Transfers. Operating under a P2B2C (platform-to-business, partners-to-clients) model, MetaComp provides its clients with an integrated end-to-end suite of services, empowering them to confidently enter the digital asset market with much-needed safety, security, and compliance assurance. Together with its parent company, Metaverse Green Exchange Pte. Ltd. (a MAS-licensed CMS holder permitted to carry out, inter alia, brokerage and custody services), MetaComp introduces its suite of services through CAMP (Client Assets Management Platform) which allow businesses to develop and scale their digital asset offerings through various products and/or services such as over-the-counter transactions, fiat payments, digital asset custody and prime brokerage.

Role Overview

The Project Manager will be responsible for managing multiple business and technology projects across MetaComp, working closely with Product, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams.
This role requires a highly structured and hands-on individual who can translate business objectives into actionable project plans, coordinate stakeholders, identify risks and dependencies, and drive projects to successful completion.
The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-paced fintech environment
, can manage ambiguity, and is capable of influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Delivery

Lead end-to-end project management from initiation, planning and execution through to launch and post-implementation review.
Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, timelines, resources, and success metrics.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, RAID logs, action trackers, and project documentation.
Monitor project progress and ensure key milestones and deliverables are achieved on schedule.
Proactively identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks and drive appropriate mitigation plans.
Escalate critical issues and provide management with clear recommendations and decision points.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

Coordinate stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations, Sales and other business functions.
Establish clear ownership and accountability for project deliverables.
Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, steering committees, and status updates.
Ensure effective communication across teams and maintain alignment on project objectives and priorities.
Manage conflicting priorities and drive stakeholders toward timely decisions and resolution.

Business & Technology Projects

Manage projects involving new product launches, system implementations, process improvements, regulatory initiatives, market expansion, operational transformation, and technology delivery.
Work with Product and Technology teams to translate business requirements into clear project deliverables.
Coordinate UAT, implementation, migration, operational readiness, and go-live activities where applicable.
Ensure business, operational, compliance, and technology requirements are incorporated into project plans.

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve business processes, workflows, systems, and operational efficiency.
Establish standardised project management methodologies, templates, and governance frameworks.
Conduct post-project reviews and document lessons learned.
Drive continuous improvement across project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

Reporting & Governance

Provide regular project status updates to senior management, highlighting progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and key decisions required.
Prepare management reports, project dashboards, and executive-level presentations.
Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure appropriate governance and approval processes are followed.
Track project KPIs, budgets, resources, and delivery performance where applicable.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
5+ years of project management experience
, preferably within fintech, payments, financial services, technology, or a similarly fast-paced environment.
Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional projects from initiation to completion.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across seniority levels and functions.
Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to operate independently, take ownership, and drive projects forward in an ambiguous environment.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in payments, digital assets, banking, fintech, FX, cards, or financial infrastructure
.
Experience managing technology implementation or product delivery projects.
Experience working with regulatory, compliance, AML/KYC, risk, or operational transformation projects.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, or equivalent project management certification.
Experience working with distributed or regional teams across multiple markets.
Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Lark, Confluence, Notion, Asana, or similar platforms.

Key Competencies
Ownership & Accountability
— Takes responsibility for outcomes and drives projects to completion.
Structured Thinking
— Able to break complex initiatives into clear, actionable workstreams.
Stakeholder Management
— Builds alignment and manages stakeholders effectively without direct authority.
Execution Excellence
— Strong focus on timelines, quality, and delivery.
Problem Solving
— Identifies issues early and develops practical solutions.
Communication
— Communicates clearly and concisely with both working teams and senior management.
Adaptability
— Comfortable working in a high-growth, constantly evolving environment.
Teamwork
— Collaborates effectively across functions and markets.

Why Join MetaComp?

Join a high-growth fintech
operating at the intersection of payments, digital assets, and financial infrastructure.
Work on high-impact, cross-functional projects with direct visibility to senior management.
Exposure to regional and international markets and regulatory environments.
Opportunity to work across Product, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Finance and Commercial
functions.
High level of ownership and autonomy in a fast-moving environment.
Be part of a team building scalable financial infrastructure for the next generation of digital finance.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We celebrate diversity in all its forms—background, ethnicity, gender, identity, orientation, experience, and thought—and believe it strengthens our culture and our work. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
